newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia says Jan-Aug non-CIS oil exports 67 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russia says Jan-Aug non-CIS oil exports 67 mln T.

text.p: Russia exported 67.020 million tonnes of crude oil over January to August to countries outside the Commonwealth of Independent States, State Customs Committee data obtained by Reuters on Tuesday said.
The committee said Russia had exported 74.449 million tonnes to all destinations over the eight months, including 7.429 million tonnes to CIS destinations.
The State Statistics Committee on September 24 released different figures for Russian oil exports over the same period.
It said Russian crude exports over January to August were 83.435 million tonnes.
